label.fqdn_hint: This site's hosts: {{serverNames}}. List those that should go straight to SAML login.
label.fqdn_hint_no_server_names: List the hosts that should go straight to SAML login.

samlLoginProvider.description: On this site, unauthenticated visitors get a login page offering both the credentials form and SAML sign-in. Visitors arriving on the hosts listed below skip it and go straight to the SAML connect endpoint (/home.connect.saml); the logout button then lands on a public page.

disabled.hint: When the list is empty, nobody is sent to SAML automatically: every visitor gets the login page offering SAML.

samlLoginProvider.scope: This setting applies to the site {{siteKey}} only. Each site has its own list.
samlLoginProvider.scopeSystemsite: It also governs every host that no site declares (for example the editing host): list such a host here to send it straight to SAML.

update.failed: Failed to save the SAML auto-login configuration.

load.failed: Failed to load the SAML auto-login configuration

refetch.failed: Your changes were saved, but the display could not be refreshed automatically. Reload the page to confirm the current configuration.

fqdn.invalid: Enter a comma-separated list of valid hostnames (e.g. editpp.jahia.com), or leave the field empty.
fqdn.notSiteHost: Each host must be one of this site's hosts: {{serverNames}}.

samlLoginProvider.samlMissing: No SAML connector is set up for {{siteKey}}: its visitors keep the standard Jahia login until one is (Authentication settings of the site).
